content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Fredericksburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for Fredericksburg professionals entering project management roles across healthcare, government, construction, and education sectors. Verify your credentials before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Designed for working professionals, the intensive format covers PMBOK® principles and real-world application. Attend from anywhere in Fredericksburg on a schedule that fits your career and personal commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit PMI Application and Exam Fee
steps_items.text: After completing your education, register directly with PMI, provide proof of your 23 contact hours, and submit your exam application. Pay the required examination fee through PMI's portal to schedule your test date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources to reinforce PMBOK® knowledge and test-taking strategy. On exam day, you'll answer 150 multiple-choice questions. Pass the assessment to earn your CAPM credential and demonstrate project management readiness to employers.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through continued learning, volunteer work, or additional training. Renew before expiration to keep your credential active and competitive in your job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
